g.text: J28 CLUTCH OUTPUT: pin 1 = switched + endpoint; pin 2 = power GND. POWER_PATH_NOT_CONNECTED. DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO FIRE.

g.desc: J28 CLUTCH OUTPUT: pin 1 = switched + endpoint; pin 2 = power GND. POWER_PATH_NOT_CONNECTED. DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO FIRE.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J24: 1=GND/COM, 2=NC_N, 3=NO_N. Never short NC_N to NO_N. Both LOW is forbidden for U2.2.

g.desc: J24: 1=GND/COM, 2=NC_N, 3=NO_N. Never short NC_N to NO_N. Both LOW is forbidden for U2.2.

g.text: J25: 1=+3V3, 2=THERMAL_OK, 3=GND, 4=EXT_SAFETY_ENABLE. 3V3 ONLY — NOT A COIL DRIVER.

g.desc: J25: 1=+3V3, 2=THERMAL_OK, 3=GND, 4=EXT_SAFETY_ENABLE. 3V3 ONLY — NOT A COIL DRIVER.

g.text: THERMAL_OK: isolated contact closed to +3V3 when healthy; R22 pulls LOW on open wire.

g.desc: THERMAL_OK: isolated contact closed to +3V3 when healthy; R22 pulls LOW on open wire.

g.text: External STOP and independent thermal limit MUST ALSO directly interrupt the protective contactor coil circuit.

g.desc: External STOP and independent thermal limit MUST ALSO directly interrupt the protective contactor coil circuit.

g.text: Output buffering, physical fuel disconnection, independent post-purge, layout and bench validation remain pending.

g.desc: Output buffering, physical fuel disconnection, independent post-purge, layout and bench validation remain pending.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: DRAFT_NOT_FOR_ORDER: LM5013 +5V output is intentionally OPEN at root. No connection to DevKit 5V/VIN until USB reverse-feed arbitration is proven on the exact v1.1 board.

g.desc: DRAFT_NOT_FOR_ORDER: LM5013 +5V output is intentionally OPEN at root. No connection to DevKit 5V/VIN until USB reverse-feed arbitration is proven on the exact v1.1 board.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J10/J11 pin order is OUR HARNESS, not the manufacturer's header order.

g.desc: J10/J11 pin order is OUR HARNESS, not the manufacturer's header order.

g.text: 1 Vin=3V3; 2 GND; 3 SCK; 4 SDO; 5 SDI; 6 CS; 7 DRDY.

g.desc: 1 Vin=3V3; 2 GND; 3 SCK; 4 SDO; 5 SDI; 6 CS; 7 DRDY.

g.text: K probes connect to T+/T- of each external module, not to this logic board.

g.desc: K probes connect to T+/T- of each external module, not to this logic board.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: HARDWARE FUEL PERMISSION — DRAFT / NO FIRED OPERATION

g.desc: HARDWARE FUEL PERMISSION — DRAFT / NO FIRED OPERATION

g.text: U2.1: fault-dominant allow latch. U2.2: SPDT RESET debounce.

g.desc: U2.1: fault-dominant allow latch. U2.2: SPDT RESET debounce.

g.text: RESET: momentary DPDT, break-before-make; hardware pole J24 COM/NC/NO; isolated second pole -> GPIO6 RESET_REQUEST/GND.

g.desc: RESET: momentary DPDT, break-before-make; hardware pole J24 COM/NC/NO; isolated second pole -> GPIO6 RESET_REQUEST/GND.

g.text: U7 supervises +3V3 (G33 = 3.08 V nominal); watchdog recovery alone CANNOT re-arm.

g.desc: U7 supervises +3V3 (G33 = 3.08 V nominal); watchdog recovery alone CANNOT re-arm.

g.text: J21 SAFETY_OK is now a MONITOR OUTPUT. Never drive it externally or bridge to +3V3.

g.desc: J21 SAFETY_OK is now a MONITOR OUTPUT. Never drive it externally or bridge to +3V3.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J27 GLOW OUTPUT: pin 1 = switched + endpoint; pin 2 = power GND. POWER_PATH_NOT_CONNECTED. DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO FIRE.

g.desc: J27 GLOW OUTPUT: pin 1 = switched + endpoint; pin 2 = power GND. POWER_PATH_NOT_CONNECTED. DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO FIRE.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: RELAY DRIVER DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO FIRE / production_release=false.

g.desc: RELAY DRIVER DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO FIRE / production_release=false.

g.text: DRV8803PWPR PWP16 WIP: VM/VCLAMP <=45V incl overshoot; OUT <=50V incl flyback. Existing input protection does NOT yet guarantee these limits.

g.desc: DRV8803PWPR PWP16 WIP: VM/VCLAMP <=45V incl overshoot; OUT <=50V incl flyback. Existing input protection does NOT yet guarantee these limits.

g.text: C21 GRM21BR72A104KAC4L 100nF/100V/0805 local VM bypass. C22 EEUFS1J331L 330uF/63V/D10x25/P5 polarized bulk (+ to P24_PROTECTED). 0.45A/100us screen: Creq140.625uF; 198uF aged/tolerance screen; droop0.327273V at assigned 0.1V loop/ESR budget. This is 20C restored-condition math, NOT hot/cold guarantee.

g.desc: C21 GRM21BR72A104KAC4L 100nF/100V/0805 local VM bypass. C22 EEUFS1J331L 330uF/63V/D10x25/P5 polarized bulk (+ to P24_PROTECTED). 0.45A/100us screen: Creq140.625uF; 198uF aged/tolerance screen; droop0.327273V at assigned 0.1V loop/ESR budget. This is 20C restored-condition math, NOT hot/cold guarantee.

g.text: C23 100nF/16V/X7R/0805 is U12 local +3V3-to-GND bypass; it is locally routed to U12 pins14/7. C21 on P24_PROTECTED does not replace it.

g.desc: C23 100nF/16V/X7R/0805 is U12 local +3V3-to-GND bypass; it is locally routed to U12 pins14/7. C21 on P24_PROTECTED does not replace it.

g.text: U12 gates GLOW_CMD AND SAFETY_OK and CLEAR_OK_BASE AND RELAY_DRIVER_OK; nFAULT is open-drain with 10k pull-up. TI SCLS778D does not provide loaded 3.3V VOH/VOL guarantee for this 4.7k+DRV load; hot logic levels remain HOLD. Nexperia 74HCS08 is only a documented pin-compatible future qualification path, not an approved substitution.

g.desc: U12 gates GLOW_CMD AND SAFETY_OK and CLEAR_OK_BASE AND RELAY_DRIVER_OK; nFAULT is open-drain with 10k pull-up. TI SCLS778D does not provide loaded 3.3V VOH/VOL guarantee for this 4.7k+DRV load; hot logic levels remain HOLD. Nexperia 74HCS08 is only a documented pin-compatible future qualification path, not an approved substitution.

g.text: Dynamic fault timing, thermal/EP layout, actual coil loads, DC-bias/ageing, inrush and mechanical fixing remain HOLD.

g.desc: Dynamic fault timing, thermal/EP layout, actual coil loads, DC-bias/ageing, inrush and mechanical fixing remain HOLD.

g.text: ULN2803CDWR rejected as qualified choice: SLRS076B Table 5.3 states TJ -40..85C; 150C is absmax only; prior 127.4C<150 is NOT PASS.

g.desc: ULN2803CDWR rejected as qualified choice: SLRS076B Table 5.3 states TJ -40..85C; 150C is absmax only; prior 127.4C<150 is NOT PASS.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: R1: ROOM PULL-UP. R2/R3: SPI CS PULL-UPS. R4-R12: DEFINED LOW / DISCONNECTED SAFETY STATUS.

g.desc: R1: ROOM PULL-UP. R2/R3: SPI CS PULL-UPS. R4-R12: DEFINED LOW / DISCONNECTED SAFETY STATUS.

g.text: NC flags mean intentionally unused external DevKit connections, not deleted checks.

g.desc: NC flags mean intentionally unused external DevKit connections, not deleted checks.

g.text: Rev A: SPEED_CMD selects low speed through a non-overlapping changeover contact.

g.desc: Rev A: SPEED_CMD selects low speed through a non-overlapping changeover contact.

g.text: Rev B: SPEED_CMD is PWM; low-speed motor lead is isolated; independent full-speed purge path required.

g.desc: Rev B: SPEED_CMD is PWM; low-speed motor lead is isolated; independent full-speed purge path required.

g.text: ERC checks this interface network only; it cannot verify combustion, external modules or protective timing.

g.desc: ERC checks this interface network only; it cannot verify combustion, external modules or protective timing.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J13: externally regulated +5V only, never raw 24V.

g.desc: J13: externally regulated +5V only, never raw 24V.

g.text: Do not combine USB and external supply without verified power isolation.

g.desc: Do not combine USB and external supply without verified power isolation.

g.text: J12 harness: 1 VDD=3V3; 2 DQ; 3 GND. Actual DS18B20 package pinout differs.

g.desc: J12 harness: 1 VDD=3V3; 2 DQ; 3 GND. Actual DS18B20 package pinout differs.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J20/J21 carry 3V3 LOGIC ONLY. NO 24V, coil or motor current here.

g.desc: J20/J21 carry 3V3 LOGIC ONLY. NO 24V, coil or motor current here.

g.text: FUEL_PERMIT must pass through independent watchdog + latched limit chain.

g.desc: FUEL_PERMIT must pass through independent watchdog + latched limit chain.

g.text: STOP must also break the external fuel permission directly.

g.desc: STOP must also break the external fuel permission directly.

g.text: Protective fuel/glow disconnects and fan off-delay are not implemented on this sheet.

g.desc: Protective fuel/glow disconnects and fan off-delay are not implemented on this sheet.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: YD-ESP32-S3 N16R8 removable module; J1 and J3 follow the verified project pin contract.

g.desc: YD-ESP32-S3 N16R8 removable module; J1 and J3 follow the verified project pin contract.

g.text: Native KiCad project. This sheet is NOT the complete heater wiring or a manufacturing release.

g.desc: Native KiCad project. This sheet is NOT the complete heater wiring or a manufacturing release.
